ART-ANC-HUMAN.identity: A Human adventurer, medium-sized, the plain short-lived 'striver' people who persist where steadier peoples fail, shown as a traveller in a Bastion's service.
ART-ANC-HUMAN.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view mid-stride on a short patch of rutted track, walking staff planted ahead, head turned back over the shoulder toward unseen pursuit.
details: Layered road clothes: patched tunic, belted over-coat, hooded mantle pushed back
Walking staff of plain ash, scuffed iron ferrule
Short sword in a worn scabbard at the left hip
Travel pack with bedroll and tin cup lashed on
Ordinary unremarkable face, stubble, weathered skin, determined set jaw
Mud-caked boots and frayed hem
No horns, fur, scales or pointed ears: wholly ordinary proportions
ART-ANC-HUMAN.atmosphere: Plain weathered resolve, a small life walking through a vast dying land.
avoid: No exotic features: the Human must look unmarked beside the other ancestries
No armour plate or heroic pose: this is a traveller, not a Fighter
Do not copy the Elf's long cloak or the Halfling's hood
sources: 6.9 Ancestries: Human

ART-ANC-HALFLING.identity: A Halfling adventurer, small-sized, hearth-and-hidden-roads folk who survive by staying unseen, shown as a capable traveller in a Bastion's service.
ART-ANC-HALFLING.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view, crouched low on one knee, sling hand drawn back, eyes alert and wary.
details: Child-sized body with adult proportions: stocky limbs, broad round face, no beard
Deep hooded cloak with mended hem
Leather sling with a round stone, other stones in a belt pouch
Well-kept pack with a small cooking pot and ladle tied on the outside
Bare, hairy-topped feet or light soft boots
A tuft of weeds and a fist-sized stone at its feet that hint at its small scale
Wary but calm expression
ART-ANC-HALFLING.atmosphere: Quiet alertness, hearth-smoke practicality in a hostile place.
avoid: Do not make it a cute child or cartoon: adult, grounded proportions
No pointed ears (that is Elf/Gnome territory)
No wall, building or other figure
No sword: its kit is sling, pack and pot
must: Small, about child height, with adult proportions
sources: 6.9 Ancestries: Halfling

ART-ANC-DWARF.identity: A Dwarf adventurer, medium-sized but broad and heavy, from sealed stone halls and old craft traditions, shown as a hardened traveller in a Bastion's service.
ART-ANC-DWARF.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view, braced wide-stanced, lantern held forward in one hand with a round shield strapped on that forearm, handaxe ready in the other hand.
details: Very broad shoulders, short thick limbs, stocky frame, human-sized but far heavier in build
Long braided beard with metal rings, heavy brow, deep-set eyes used to the dark
Heavy mail or plated chest armour worn with ease, scuffed and re-riveted
Round shield strapped on the lantern arm, handaxe in the other hand
Lantern with a shuttered iron housing
Thick hobnailed boots planted on a small patch of worn flagstone
Stone-cut craftsmanship in belt buckle and axe head
ART-ANC-DWARF.atmosphere: Granite stubbornness, a person built to be struck and remain standing.
avoid: Not a comic dwarf: serious proportions, no oversized hat or cartoon nose
Do not give it a greataxe (that is the Orc adventurer's kit)
No stair, doorway or other scenery
must: Broad and heavy build: shoulders very wide for the height, thick short limbs, no slender lines
sources: 6.9 Ancestries: Dwarf

ART-ANC-ELF.identity: An Elf adventurer, medium-sized, tall and lean, a graceful, long-memoried traveller in a Bastion's service.
ART-ANC-ELF.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view standing at ease on a patch of leaf litter, longbow lowered in one hand, head tilted as if listening, one hand resting on the quiver.
details: Tall, lean build with long limbs and a long neck
Long pointed ears swept back, high cheekbones, calm eyes that notice much
Long weathered travelling cloak, faded and mended, pinned at one shoulder
Longbow taller than the Halfling's whole body, quiver of fletched arrows
Soft boots and bracers; light, unfussy kit
Fine, sparse hair loose or in a narrow braid
Sparse leaf litter at its feet

avoid: Not a Deep Elf: pale skin and dark armour belong to that entry, here keep light open clothes
Do not pose it drawing the bow: it is at ease
sources: 6.9 Ancestries: Elf

ART-ANC-GNOME.identity: A Gnome adventurer, small-sized, a clever, precise tinkerer drawn to dangerous devices, shown as a traveller in a Bastion's service.
ART-ANC-GNOME.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view kneeling over a small trap mechanism lying on the ground, eyepiece lens flipped down, probing it with a thin tool while a small crossbow hangs ready on the back.

Bandolier of tinkering tools, picks, lenses and small screwdrivers
Small crossbow slung across the back
Heavy satchel bulging with coils of wire and cogs
Ink-stained leather gloves, apron over practical clothes
Lightly goggled cap or hood, neat tidy clothing
Mechanism with gears showing that it is a trap or lock
ART-ANC-GNOME.atmosphere: Absorbed curiosity, a happy student of lethal things.
avoid: Do not turn it into a steampunk robot or give it huge goggles beyond one lens
Do not duplicate the Halfling's sling and cloak silhouette
sources: 6.9 Ancestries: Gnome

ART-ANC-GOBLIN.identity: A Goblin adventurer, small-sized, quick of hand and foot, shown as a hired hero in a Bastion's employ (an ally, not a raider).
ART-ANC-GOBLIN.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view creeping forward, lantern held out and low in one hand, short blade held back ready in the other, poised to dodge.

ART-ANC-ORC.identity: An Orc adventurer, medium-sized and very powerfully built, shown as a sworn hireling in a Bastion's service (not a raider).

Plain Bastion tabard worn over the armour, no lettering
Wide boots, belt with plain pouches
No trophies on display

Shortbow at full draw, arrow at the cheek
Elven dagger at the belt
Quiver on the hip, snares coiled at the belt
Fletching and bracers worn and mended
Boots with sinew-bound tops, mud-flecked
A few ferns at its feet
ART-CLA-RANGER.atmosphere: Focused calm of a hunter at full draw.
avoid: Not the Assassin: no hooded crouch, no dagger-first pose
Do not give it a sword
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Ranger

ART-CLA-CLERIC.identity: A Cleric, Caster class: faith kept in silence; packages of Mace, Targe, Ring Shirt, Quarterstaff, Holy Water, Bandages.
ART-CLA-CLERIC.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view kneeling in prayer on one knee on a small patch of bare flagstone, mace laid across the thigh, targe on the back, head bowed.
details: Ring shirt under a plain habit-like surcoat with a bare circle mark
Flanged mace laid across the knee
Targe slung on the back
Satchel with bandages and a small stoppered vial
Rosary-like prayer cord wound around a wrist
Tonsured or cropped hair, solemn face
ART-CLA-CLERIC.atmosphere: Tired devotion in an unanswering silence.
avoid: Not the Paladin: no oath-sword, no standing knight pose
No shrine, altar, candles or masonry
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Cleric

ART-CLA-PALADIN.identity: A Paladin, Hybrid class: bearer of an unbending oath; packages of Mace, Longsword, Targe, Ring Shirt, Quarterstaff, Gambeson.
ART-CLA-PALADIN.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view standing upright, longsword planted point-down before the feet, both hands folded on the pommel, head bowed.
details: Ring shirt with a worn surcoat of cloth, torn but clean, no readable device
Longsword with a plain cross-guard, point resting in cracked flagstones
Targe slung on the left arm or back
Healer's kit pouch on the belt
Bare-headed with cropped hair or a helm hung at the belt
Strong shoulders squared, face composed
avoid: Not the Cleric: no kneeling, no mace
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Paladin

ART-CLA-WIZARD.identity: A Wizard, Caster class: scholar of rebuilt power; packages of Quarterstaff, Magnifying Glass, Torches, Elven Dagger, Sling, Scroll of Arcane Bolt.
ART-CLA-WIZARD.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view standing, one hand raising a small scroll to a magnifying glass held in the other, staff tucked under the arm.
details: Long layered robe, scuffed hem, ink stains on sleeves
Quarterstaff under the arm
Round magnifying glass with a brass rim
Scroll partly unrolled, filled with abstract scribbles, no letters
Satchel and book strap across the chest
Elven dagger at the belt
Thin face, a short beard or cropped grey hair, squinting
avoid: Not the Sorcerer or Psion: no spell effects or levitation
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Wizard

ART-CLA-PSION.identity: A Psion, Caster class: thought sharpened into a weapon; packages of Dagger, Hide Cuirass, Targe, Throwing Knives, Gambeson, Quarterstaff.
ART-CLA-PSION.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view standing very still with one hand extended, palm out, while three throwing knives hang in the air in front, points turned outward.
details: Three throwing knives suspended in the air at slightly staggered heights
Gambeson or hide cuirass, plain and tight
Dagger sheathed at the belt
Eyes closed or blank white pupils
Hair lifting slightly as in a hush of wind
Gaunt face, taut jaw, veins at the temple
Stillness: no movement lines
avoid: Not the Wizard: no staff, no books
Do not draw telekinetic arcs or lines; just suspended knives
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Psion

ART-CLA-TRICKSTER.identity: A Trickster, Hybrid class: shaper of belief and illusion; packages of Elven Rapier, Shortbow, Elven Dagger, Smokestick, Caltrops, Lockpicks.
ART-CLA-TRICKSTER.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view sidestepping a blow with a flourish, rapier flicked out in a feint, trailing cloak flap, smoke curling at the feet.
details: Elven rapier with a swept hilt in a feinting line
Leather coat with ornate stitching and mismatched cuffs
Smokestick burning at the belt, thin wisp rising
Small bag of caltrops at the hip
A faint extra outline (a second, thinner-line copy) of the same figure just beside the shoulder
Sly half-smile, tilted head
Light dancing footwork, one heel lifted
ART-CLA-TRICKSTER.atmosphere: Poised mischief, the moment before everyone looks the wrong way.
avoid: Not the Rogue: no lockpicking, no crouch
Do not draw two solid figures: the double must be pale line only
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Trickster

ART-CLA-SORCERER.identity: A Sorcerer, Caster class: carrier of unasked-for power; packages of Quarterstaff, Dagger, Sling, Gambeson, Bandages.
ART-CLA-SORCERER.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view bracing against its own power, one arm extended with a palm facing the viewer and a small crackling arc of ink-drawn lightning, the other hand clamping the bandaged forearm.
details: Bandaged forearms, old scars and fresh dressings
Hair and cloak flung back by unseen wind
Plain gambeson, torn sleeve
Sling and dagger at belt
Wide eyes with solid-black pupils and a thin white ring
Veins or branching marks on the neck
Lightning rendered as sharp black zigzag strokes, not glow
avoid: Not the Wizard: no scrolls, no magnifier, no staff pose
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Sorcerer

ART-CLA-DRUID.identity: A Druid, Caster class: servant of the world's slow reclamation; packages of Quarterstaff, Club, Wooden Shield, Sling, Elven Sickle, Leather Coat.
ART-CLA-DRUID.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view standing barefoot in tall grass, staff planted in one hand and the other palm open and low, a crow perched on the staff head.
details: Leather coat covered in lichen stains and patched with bark-like cloth
Quarterstaff carved with root-like twists
Sprig crown of leaves and a few small twigs in the hair
Sickle at the belt
Bare feet in grass, vines curling round the staff
Weather-lined face, calm eyes
Tall grass around the shins, a few fine rain lines
avoid: Not the Tier 3 tradition image: no bark skin or antlers
No animal companion beyond the crow
sources: 6.13 Hero Classes: Druid

ART-TRA-TIER-1-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.identity: Tier 1 Arcane Spells: the first lessons of any surviving academy (Arcane Bolt, Burning Hands, Ice Ray, Force Push, Phase Step).
ART-TRA-TIER-1-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.composition: A young apprentice in three-quarter view beside a scarred practice post, conjuring a small flame in one palm while a shimmer of force bends the air before the other hand; mid-height. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Apprentice in a plain, too-large robe with chalk and ink stains
Practice post with chopped and scorched marks
Small flame drawn as a single clean ink flame cupped in the palm
Air distortion drawn as bent parallel lines before the other palm
A few cracked flagstones underfoot
Anxious concentrated face, tongue-tip between teeth
A battered wooden staff leaning on the post
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
Not a grown Wizard: young, small and unsure
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.3 Arcane Spells, Tier 1

ART-TRA-TIER-2-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.identity: Tier 2 Arcane Spells: wartime spells copied from libraries since burned (Fireball, Haste, Blink, Sleep, Dispel).
ART-TRA-TIER-2-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.composition: A wizard seated at a small folding desk, copying from a single scorched, half-burned page onto a fresh sheet; above the fresh sheet the copied spell already stirs as a small sphere of ink flame hovering over the quill; three-quarter view. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Hunched wizard on a camp stool at a folding desk, quill in hand
One scorched loose page with charred edges and unreadable marks, the only remnant of a burned library
A small sphere of flame drawn as clean ink tongues hovering above the fresh sheet
A few sparks drifting up from the sphere as stipple
Spilled ink pot and loose pages
A satchel of rescued scraps at the feet
Intent face lit from below by the small flame
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
No bookshelves, library hall or burning building
No large explosion: the flame stays small
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.3 Arcane Spells, Tier 2

ART-TRA-TIER-3-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.identity: Tier 3 Arcane Spells: the spells the towers killed to keep (Meteor Impact, Disintegrate, Time Break, Reality Warp).
ART-TRA-TIER-3-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.composition: A wizard standing amid ash and cipher-scraps on a cracked mosaic floor, a sealed, chained book clutched to their chest while the scraps lift and turn slowly around it, two robed corpses sprawled at their feet; high-angle view. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Standing wizard in tattered robes, one hand holding a sealed book bound with chains and a lock
Two robed corpses sprawled on the fractured mosaic floor
Drifting ash and ink-scrap pieces
Ash scraps lifting and circling the sealed book as if drawn to it
A toppled orrery frame
Wary glance upward
Hard diagonal light in hatch
ART-TRA-TIER-3-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.atmosphere: Grim scavenger's triumph over a tomb of scholars.
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
No gore or visible wounds on the corpses
Do not make the wizard heroic
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.3 Arcane Spells, Tier 3

ART-TRA-TIER-1-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.identity: Tier 1 Divine Prayers: plain mercies (Sacred Flame, Guiding Light, Healing Touch, Blessing, Sanctuary).
ART-TRA-TIER-1-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.composition: A priest raising a lantern whose light falls on a wounded soldier seated at their feet, the wound visibly knitting closed; mid-shot. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Priest in a plain habit with a hooded head, lantern held high
Soldier seated on the ground, bandaged arm in lantern light
Wound drawn as a long line fading to fine hairlines
Cone of light drawn with sparse straight radiating strokes
Dust motes as stippling
Weary but tender expressions
avoid: No halo or glow wash: light shown only with line and white space
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.4 Divine Prayers, Tier 1

ART-TRA-TIER-2-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.identity: Tier 2 Divine Prayers: prayers answered less often and at greater cost (Radiant Burst, Circle of Protection, Guardian Angel, Benediction).
ART-TRA-TIER-2-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.composition: A weary cleric standing at a cracked roadside shrine-stone, tipping coins one by one into an offering dish as a faint circle of protection rises around their feet; low side view. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Standing cleric, hood back, weary face, one hand tipping coins into a dish
Waist-high cracked shrine-stone with a toppled small statue
Open ledger with abstract ruled lines lying on the shrine-stone
Two guttering candles beside the dish
A ring of thin upright ink strokes rising from the ground around the cleric
Satchel and travel-worn boots
Rain streaks beginning
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.4 Divine Prayers, Tier 2

ART-TRA-TIER-3-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.identity: Tier 3 Divine Prayers: prayers demanded rather than asked (Divine Wrath, Heaven's Spear, Resurrection Light, Sunburst).
ART-TRA-TIER-3-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.composition: A priest with arms raised on a bare hilltop, demanding, as a vast ambiguous shape takes form in the storm clouds above; low angle looking up. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Small silhouette on a barren hilltop, robes whipped by wind
Arms thrown wide, head tipped back
Storm clouds drawn as dense swirling crosshatch
A vast, ambiguous form in the clouds: shoulders, perhaps a hand, not a clear face
Beams of sparse straight lines breaking from the cloud
One bare thorn tree on the hilltop
Tiny discarded staff at the priest's feet
avoid: Do not resolve the cloud shape into a clear god or angel
Do not make the priest triumphant
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.4 Divine Prayers, Tier 3

ART-TRA-TIER-1-SORCERIES-D20.identity: Tier 1 Sorceries: cheap blood workings that never fail (Chaos Bolt, Bloodspark, Scorch Step, Ember Net).
ART-TRA-TIER-1-SORCERIES-D20.composition: A close view of a sorcerer's cut palm and forearm, drops of blood rising and twisting into a small crackling spark; the arm thins into white paper at the elbow.
details: Open palm with a shallow cut
Drops of blood rising as small black teardrops
A spark of ink-drawn jagged lines at the apex
Old scars across the wrist and forearm
Thin bandage strip unwound
Plain sleeve rolled to the elbow
avoid: No gore pools or wound close-up detail
Do not show a face fully
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.5 Sorceries, Tier 1

ART-TRA-TIER-2-SORCERIES-D20.identity: Tier 2 Sorceries: the price climbs with the power (Volatile Fireball, Chain Shock, Stormskin, Shardstorm).
ART-TRA-TIER-2-SORCERIES-D20.composition: A gaunt sorcerer with scar-laddered forearms channelling a crackling storm between their hands; three-quarter view, standing braced. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Forearms bare, with ladder-like rows of old scars
Gaunt hollow-cheeked face
Storm drawn as a knot of hard black jagged lightning between the hands
Hair and tattered sleeves flaring outward
Cracked flagstone floor under braced feet
Fresh drops of blood on the wrists
Dark robes in torn layers
avoid: Not a Tier 3 consumed look: body intact
Do not copy Tier 1's palm close-up
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.5 Sorceries, Tier 2

ART-TRA-TIER-3-SORCERIES-D20.identity: Tier 3 Sorceries: workings that do not care whether the caster survives (Catastrophe Sphere, Gravity Collapse, Ashen Vortex, Meteor Line).
ART-TRA-TIER-3-SORCERIES-D20.composition: A sorcerer half-consumed by their own working, a vortex of force tearing up the ground around them, two or three villagers praying on their knees, small and faint at a safe distance; the sorcerer centre. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Sorcerer lit from within by white-line cracks across skin, body partly dissolving to ash flecks
Vortex shown as spiral crosshatching tearing a crater
Flying chunks of earth and flagstone
Two or three kneeling villagers, small and faint at the vignette edge
Cloak torn into streamers
Pained, resigned face
avoid: No fleeing or large villagers: they stay small and praying
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.5 Sorceries, Tier 3

ART-TRA-TIER-1-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.identity: Tier 1 Druidic Rituals: small agreements with root, weather and beast (Thorn Dart, Entangling Roots, Regrowth, Fog Bank).
ART-TRA-TIER-1-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.composition: A druid kneeling with one palm pressed to an exposed root as thin roots curl up around the wrist and a low fog begins to gather, a hare watching; low view at root level. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Kneeling druid in a lichen-stained coat, hood back
Hand flat on a thick twisting root
Hare sitting alert in the foreground
Thin roots curling up from the earth around the wrist
Low fog drawn as sparse horizontal strokes
Damp moss and fern detail
Quarterstaff laid on the ground
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.6 Druidic Rituals, Tier 1

ART-TRA-TIER-2-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.identity: Tier 2 Druidic Rituals: speaking the wild's language (Wall of Vines, Spike Growth, Summon Dire Wolf, Wild Dominion).
ART-TRA-TIER-2-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.composition: A druid speaking aloud as two or three trees at the vignette's edge bend toward them and roots heave up out of the earth; low view with the druid centre. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Druid standing with open mouth, arms spread palm-down
Two or three trees leaning inward with branches reaching like fingers
Roots heaving up from broken ground
Falling leaf scatter and flung soil in stipple
Ferns flattening in a ring of wind
Cloak flaring
Staff in one hand
avoid: Do not let the trees have faces
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.6 Druidic Rituals, Tier 2

ART-TRA-TIER-3-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.identity: Tier 3 Druidic Rituals: becoming a clause in the oldest contract (Avatar of the Wild, Verdant Dominion, Summon Treant, Maelstrom).
ART-TRA-TIER-3-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.composition: A druid half-merged with an ancient oak, bark creeping over their skin and branches rising like antlers from their head; frontal three-quarter figure growing out of the trunk. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Lower body fused with the oak trunk
Bark texture climbing arms and chest
Branches forming antlers from the head
Face still human, eyes calm
Roots spreading across the ground
Leaves in sparse stipple
Dark hollow in the trunk beside
avoid: Not a Treant monster: a person fusing, not a giant
Do not make the face monstrous
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.6 Druidic Rituals, Tier 3

ART-TRA-TIER-1-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20.identity: Tier 1 Psychic Abilities: the first disciplines of the unquiet mind (Telekinetic Push, Precognition, Psychic Veil, Mind Link).
ART-TRA-TIER-1-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20.composition: A psion seated cross-legged with closed eyes, pebbles hovering in a slow ring around them and a candle flame standing perfectly still; straight-on view, symmetrical. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Seated figure in simple robes with closed eyes
Ring of small pebbles hovering at different heights
Candle with a flame drawn as a perfectly upright narrow tongue
Stone floor with a faint chalk circle
Calm, drawn face
Hands resting open on the knees
avoid: Not the Psion class pose of hovering knives
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.7 Psychic Abilities, Tier 1

ART-TRA-TIER-2-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20.identity: Tier 2 Psychic Abilities: each ability leaves a mark the psion learns to hide (Psychic Lance, Mind Control, Temporal Skew, Psychic Renewal).
ART-TRA-TIER-2-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20.composition: A psion alone, leaning one shoulder on a rough boulder, hiding a trembling hand from which the air ripples faintly, fine cracks of strain around their eyes; mid-shot. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Figure leaning on a rough boulder
One hand clasped in the other to hide a tremor
Hairline cracks radiating from the eyes like fine crazing
Sweat beads and tired face
Faint concentric ripples bending the air around the hidden hand
Collar pulled high
Drip of dark fluid from the nose
ART-TRA-TIER-2-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20.atmosphere: Private strain and fear of being seen.
avoid: No thick or glowing cracks: thin lines only
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.7 Psychic Abilities, Tier 2

ART-TRA-TIER-3-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20.identity: Tier 3 Psychic Abilities: thought and world merge (Gravity Singularity, Reality Shear, Telekinetic Crush, Mass Domination).
ART-TRA-TIER-3-PSYCHIC-ABILITIES-D20.composition: A psion on open ground where stone steps and a wall rise from nothing at their gaze, two or three small enemy soldiers stumbling at the vignette's edge as the ground obeys the psion's thought; psion centre-left. Small vignette, densest at the caster and thinning into white paper.
details: Psion standing still with a locked gaze, hand slightly raised
Rising stone steps and a wall emerging from the ground in stacked blocks
Ground cracks and floating debris fragments
Two or three small enemy soldiers tripping and falling back
Dust drawn as stipple
Tattered coat edges lifting
avoid: No monsters: the enemies are ordinary soldiers
Do not use the Tier 1 pebble ring
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.7 Psychic Abilities, Tier 3

ART-MON-GIANT-TARANTULA.identity: Giant Tarantula, Greenmark Skirmisher, small: a hand-span of bristled legs around a body the size of a war helm, a forest-floor venomous hunter.
ART-MON-GIANT-TARANTULA.composition: Low three-quarter ground view of the spider stalking across leaf litter on stilted, deliberate legs, forelegs raised, fangs lifted; a discarded war helm beside it for scale.
details: Exactly eight legs, jointed and tipped with small claws
Body the size of a war helm, hairy abdomen and cephalothorax
Bristle hairs suggested by short hatch flicks along the contours, not covering every surface
Two large fangs with a bead of venom at the tips
Cluster of eight eyes on a small raised bump
Palps in front of the fangs
Leaf litter and a rusted iron helm for scale
Gripping toe-pads suggesting it can climb walls
ART-MON-GIANT-TARANTULA.atmosphere: Patient, stilted menace in damp leaf litter.
avoid: No web: it spins no snares
Do not make it larger than a dog
must: Exactly eight legs
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Giant Tarantula [Skirmisher]

ART-MON-GOBLIN.identity: Goblin, Greenmark Minion, small: a knee-high green-grey raider of ruined steadings that fights in chittering mobs.
ART-MON-GOBLIN.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view, hunched and scuttling forward, notched blade out in front, sling and stone pouch at the belt.
details: Knee-high, green-grey (rendered as heavy hatching) wiry body, all elbows and knees
Large pointed ears, long nose, wide mouth full of crooked teeth
Notched, jagged short blade in the right hand
Sling of river stones: leather strap and a bulging pouch of round stones on the belt
Rag loincloth and strips of stolen leather
Malicious narrowed eyes
A few chewed bones on the trampled ground at its feet
avoid: Not the Goblin ancestry hero: no clean kit, no lantern, no tabard
Not the Cave Goblin (blind black eyes) nor Snow Goblin (fur parka)
Do not give a spear (that is the Cave Goblin)
No other goblins or mob silhouettes
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Goblin [Minion]

ART-MON-BEASTMAN.identity: Beastman, Greenmark Minion, medium: a hunched man-shape topped with the head of a goat or boar, black claws, a forest-edge warband raider.
ART-MON-BEASTMAN.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view, bent forward and running, both clawed hands spread wide, head low.
details: Goat head with swept-back horns, slotted pupils and a beard
Heavy shaggy fur over a hunched human frame
Black claws on both hands
Goat-like digitigrade lower legs with hooves
Ragged belt of hide strips, no weapon
Torn ear, scarred muzzle, open snarling mouth
Trampled bracken underfoot
ART-MON-BEASTMAN.atmosphere: Feral grievance, an animal with a grudge.
avoid: No weapons: its attack is Claws
Do not copy the Satyr Reveler (laurel crown, pipes, playful stance)
Do not make it a minotaur
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Beastman [Minion]

ART-MON-BANDIT.identity: Bandit, Greenmark Soldier, medium: a deserter or broken tithe-collector turned forest raider, fighting with shortbow from cover and shortsword up close.
ART-MON-BANDIT.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view crouched low on one knee, shortbow at half-draw, shortsword laid on the ground within reach.
details: Mismatched scavenged armour: a cracked leather jerkin, one iron pauldron
Shortbow at half-draw with an arrow nocked
Shortsword on the ground beside the knee
Dirty hood and cloth mask pulled below the chin
Hungry, hard face with stubble
Quiver on hip, torn cloak
A few ferns at the knee
avoid: Not the Bandit Captain: no officer's cloak, no heavy crossbow
Not an adventurer class: no clean kit
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Bandit [Soldier]

ART-MON-SATYR-REVELER.identity: Satyr Reveler, Greenmark Controller, medium: a goat-legged laurel-crowned fey piper whose music floods listeners with terror or lulls them.
ART-MON-SATYR-REVELER.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view capering on one hoof, pipes at the lips, curved knife thrust in the belt, firelight raking one side.
details: Goat legs with cloven hooves and shaggy thighs
Curled ram-like horns and pointed ears
Laurel crown, withered and brown
Bone-white pipes of many reeds raised to the mouth
Curved knife in a belt sheath
Bare human chest, hollow cheeks, wild grin
Firelight rim on one side; bare trodden earth under the hooves
ART-MON-SATYR-REVELER.atmosphere: Sour, soured revelry that is not joyful.
avoid: Not the Beastman: no claws, no hunch, no snarl
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Satyr Reveler [Controller]

ART-MON-BRIARLING.identity: Briarling, Greenmark Minion, medium-sized: a hound-sized knot of animate thornwood on root-claws, a spent first line of the Antlered Warden's groves.
ART-MON-BRIARLING.composition: Low side view of the creature scuttling forward on root-claws with its barbed back bristling, head down.
details: Body of twisted tangled wood strands with barbs
Six spindly legs ending in root-claws
Hollow knothole eyes, no mouth or a split in the bark
Thorn spines in long and short rows along its back
A few withered leaves and moss tufts
Splinters spraying from a cracked limb
Mud and dead leaves under it
avoid: Not a dryad or a treant: no humanoid body, no face
Not a real hound or animal: pure wood
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Briarling [Minion]

ART-MON-DIRE-WOLF.identity: Dire Wolf, Greenmark Skirmisher, medium: a pony-sized yellow-eyed pack hunter that cuts prey from the herd.
ART-MON-DIRE-WOLF.composition: Low three-quarter view of the wolf stalking forward in a crouch, head lowered, hackles raised.
details: Shoulder as high as a pony, heavy powerful forequarters
Scarred hide with torn ear and a notch in the muzzle
Eyes with pale rings and dark pupils; yellow rendered as pale open ring
Lips curled to show long fangs
Thick ruffled mane and back hackles
Four legs only; thick paws with claws
Leaf litter under the paws
avoid: Do not make it a werewolf (no upright stance)
Do not copy Tundra Wolf (white coat, snow) or Blackfire Hound (flame)
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Dire Wolf [Skirmisher]

ART-MON-ORC.identity: Orc, Greenmark Soldier, medium: a broad, disciplined, grey-skinned raider with lower tusks, armed with battleaxe and shield, a warband member that holds formation.
ART-MON-ORC.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view mid-snarl, advancing with a heavy round shield raised on the forearm and a notched battleaxe raised in the other hand, trophies swinging from the belt.
details: Broad as a doorway, grey skin, heavy jaw, lower tusks jutting upward
One-handed battleaxe with a broad notched blade
Crude trophies: bone strings, a skull and teeth, tied at the belt and shoulder
Layered hide and iron plate scraps; a heavy iron-rimmed round shield on the forearm, battered and dented
Scarred knuckles and brow
Fierce open-mouthed snarl
Trampled earth and ash underfoot
avoid: Not the Orc ancestry hero: no tabard, no composed bearing, no clean armour
must: One-handed battleaxe in one hand, round shield on the other forearm
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, Greenmark Bestiary: Orc [Soldier] (RC488 Battleaxe, Shield Wall)

ART-MON-BUGBEAR.identity: Bugbear, Greenmark Soldier, medium: a seven-foot, shaggy, long-armed ambusher with a flat face and a spiked morningstar.
ART-MON-BUGBEAR.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view rising out of bracken, long arm already swinging a spiked morningstar from arm's reach.
details: A head and more taller than a man, arms reaching to the knees
Shaggy fur the colour of dead bracken, drawn in long hatch lines
Flat face, small eyes, broad nose, wide mouth
Spiked morningstar with a long haft
Leather scraps and a belt of bones
Knee-high bracken parting around its legs
Silent poised stance
avoid: Not an Ogre: lean and long-limbed, not a hulking thing
Not a Beastman: no horns or hooves

ART-MON-SWAMP-TROLL.composition: Three-quarter view of the troll heaving itself forward on all fours through a patch of black water, one huge clawed arm reaching; a small human figure, drawn small, light and secondary, for scale.
details: Slime-slick hulking giant on all fours
Long reaching arms with rending claws
Tusked underslung maw
Drooping skin with slime
Reeds and weeds draped on its back
Wound scars closing
Dark mire water to the shoulders
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, The Mire Bestiary: Swamp Troll [Brute]

ART-MON-HYDRA.identity: Hydra, Mire Elite, huge: a many-headed reptilian horror wallowing in the Mire's deepest pools, each serpentine neck striking on its own.
ART-MON-HYDRA.composition: Wide three-quarter view of the hydra rearing from a black pool, five to seven serpent necks striking in different directions, with three clearly biting; a small human figure at the pool's edge, drawn small, light and secondary, for scale.
details: Five to seven long serpentine necks each with a head
Heavy reptilian body half-submerged
Fanged mouths open on at least three heads
Wet scales with sparse scale marks
One stump of a head already healing beside the others
Lily pads and bones in the water
avoid: Do not draw fire from the heads
must: At least five necks, each with a head

ART-MON-BLACKWATER-WIGHT.identity: Blackwater Wight, Mire Elite, medium: a barnacled drowned corpse-warrior rising from black pools with a life-drinking drowned blade.
ART-MON-BLACKWATER-WIGHT.composition: Three-quarter view of the wight wading up out of a black pool, drowned blade held low and water pouring from its armour.
details: Barnacled corroded armour and helm
Drowned blade with algae and a notched edge
Sunken face with hollow eyes
Waterweed draped on the arms
Water streaming from the plates
Black water and mist
avoid: Not the Undead Warrior or Forsaken Knight
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, The Mire Bestiary: Blackwater Wight [Elite]

ART-MON-MIRE-TITAN.identity: Mire Titan, Mire Brute, huge: a colossal froglike amphibian horror of warty hide and lashing tentacles with a vast distensible maw. Typical individual, alone, waist-deep in fen water.
ART-MON-MIRE-TITAN.composition: Wide low view of the titan standing waist-deep in fen water, reeds and mud sliding from its body, three tentacles raised and mouth partly open; a small human figure at a safe distance, drawn small, light and secondary, for scale.
details: Froglike bulk with warty hide
Three thick lashing tentacles from the shoulders
Vast distensible maw with a ridge of small teeth
Wide flat head with small eyes
Reeds and mud sliding from its flanks
Water to the waist, ripples spreading
sources: 9.7 The Bestiary, The Mire Bestiary: Mire Titan [Brute]

ART-MON-BLACK-DRAGON.identity: Black Dragon, Mire Elite, huge: a sleek horned wyrm the colour of stagnant water with an acid breath; it flies and swims. Typical adult, alone, rising from open black water.
ART-MON-BLACK-DRAGON.composition: Wide low-angle view of the dragon rising from open black water, acid dripping from its jaws, wings partly lifting; a tiny human figure on the near bank, drawn small, light and secondary, for scale.
details: Sleek horned head with swept-back horns
Gaunt skull-like jaw with dripping acid
Wings half-lifting out of the water
Long neck draped in water weed
Pitted scales, glossy black
Water streaming and ripples
avoid: Not the Green, White or Blue Dragon: sleek, skull-like head
